entities.description: A beige, single-story building with a flat roof and rectangular windows is visible in the background, partially obscured by a person wearing a tan helmet in the foreground. The building appears to be made of stucco or concrete and has a simple, utilitarian design.

A soldier in a desert camouflage uniform stands in profile, saluting with their right hand raised to their helmet. They are wearing a tan tactical vest, a helmet with goggles, and tan combat boots in a sandy, outdoor environment.

A young male soldier in a desert camouflage uniform sits on a wooden crate, holding a black assault rifle across his lap. He wears a matching helmet with a patch, dark sunglasses, and tan combat boots, with a serious expression.

A young male soldier sits in profile facing right, wearing a digital camouflage uniform, a matching helmet, and dark sunglasses. He holds a black assault rifle with a curved magazine across his lap, wearing tan combat boots.

A male soldier wearing a desert camouflage uniform and helmet sits in profile facing right, holding a black assault rifle with a curved magazine across his lap. He wears dark sunglasses and tan combat boots, with a second rifle visible in the foreground held by another person.

equipment.weapon: black assault rifle with curved magazine

entities.description: A male soldier in his 20s or 30s is seated, wearing a desert camouflage uniform, a matching helmet with a patch, and dark sunglasses. He holds a black assault rifle across his lap with both hands, wearing tan combat boots and a serious expression.

A dark gray or black four-door crew cab pickup truck is shown in profile, facing right, with a visible side mirror, door handles, and wheels. The vehicle appears to be in motion or on a dusty, unpaved surface, with a blurred background suggesting an outdoor, possibly arid environment.

entities.description: A white bus with a blue stripe running horizontally along its side, featuring a row of rectangular windows with white frames. The bus has a slightly weathered appearance with some dirt or grime visible on the upper portion. A side mirror is attached to the front right side, and a small red and blue light is mounted on the roof near the front. The bus is parked in a desert-like environment with a clear blue sky in the background.
